canonical_project: Huawei Liaoning Region (Jinzhou) Cloud Computing Data Center
notes: Chinese IDCQuan/Sohu report says the Huawei Liaoning regional cloud data center is in Jinzhou University Science Park, originated from a 2017 Jinzhou-Huawei agreement, with 21,000 sqm floor area, 834 8 kW cabinets and capacity for more than 15,000 servers; status inferred operational from site visit/build-out wording.
